title: Out of Bounds
instructions: In many areas of the game, it's possible to reach unintended areas either via jumping, teleports in Co-op, or falling into any out of bounds pit repeatedly without touching solid ground.
notes: General reference note; no dedicated video is planned. Notable out-of-bounds examples are documented in the individual skip entries.
